entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 483 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 51.0 kDa and theoretical pI 5.61.
Contains Mur_ligase (PF01225, residues 18–92), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245, residues 105–302), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875, residues 325–451) domains.
Shares 61.7% identity over 98.1% query coverage with reviewed Pseudomonas aeruginosa MurE Q59650; analogous reviewed homologs show 56.4–59.5% identity with about 96–99% coverage.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu, producing UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu-mDAP, ADP, and phosphate.
Likely requires Mg2+ for ATP-dependent ligase activity; direct experimental evidence is inferred from reviewed homolog annotations, not measured for this exact sequence.
Expected biological role is bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis, supporting cell-wall construction, cell division, and cell-shape maintenance.
Expected localization is soluble cytoplasm/cytosol; sequence has no obvious signal peptide or transmembrane segment.

entities.name: Pseudomonas MurE Q59650
observations: Reviewed MurE ligase from Pseudomonas aeruginosa; EC 6.3.2.13; cytoplasmic; Mg2+-dependent; participates in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE adds meso-diaminopimelate to the UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu precursor during bacterial cell-wall assembly.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP → UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:23676 and EC 6.3.2.13.

entities.name: MurE Mg2+ dependence
observations: Reviewed MurE homologs are annotated as magnesium-ion-dependent ATP-binding ligases; this is a homolog-based cofactor assignment for the query sequence.
